description: One public Krate app's details, from its link or id: what it does, what it is allowed to do in plain words, its versions, size, publisher and signature, its link and its browser link. Accepts a hub link (https://hub.krate.tech/a/..., /run/...), the app's own id (v followed by 11 hex characters), a short id, or a full hash. An app removed from the registry answers with its removal notice only.

id_or_link.description: A Krate app link, or its id

name: get_app

browser_link.description: Opens the app in a browser tab, nothing to install

link.description: The app's own link; it always opens the current version

permissions.description: null when the app was published before permissions were recorded

id.description: The capability as Krate names it, e.g. store.sql

why.description: The app's own reason, as its maker wrote it

words.description: What it lets the app do, in plain words

signed.description: The app carries a publisher signature that verified

verified_publisher.description: GitHub vouched for the publisher's account

current.description: The version the app's link opens now

removed.description: The app was taken down from the registry

title: Get a Krate app
